$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.3.0-draft (pre-1.0). Contract-wide error shape as fixed in BE-05 (#19). BE-03 (#15) inherits this shape; every endpoint's errors use it.
title: Error
description: Typed error returned when a request is denied or fails. The code is stable and machine-readable; the message is short, English and safe to show in the overlay. Clients map codes and actions they do not know to UNKNOWN and still show the message.

code.description: Stable SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE identifier. Endpoints restrict this to their documented codes; the shared shape only fixes the syntax.

message.description: Human-readable explanation suitable for the overlay. Never contains a transcript, audio, credential or another user's identifier.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same request later can succeed without the caller changing anything.

action.description: What the client should do next. Clients map values they do not know to UNKNOWN.

request_id.description: Request identifier echoed from the X-Request-Id middleware so a user-visible error can be correlated with server logs. Same opaque-id syntax as voice-action-request.schema.json#/$defs/opaque_id: 1 to 128 ASCII characters, starting with a letter or digit, then letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.
